description: Generate a standalone Kotlin/Ktor backend (Docker-ready) on this machine. Call backend_describe first. Writes <outputDir>/<projectName>; never overwrites an existing non-empty folder.

appName.description: Service name: 2-31 lowercase letters, digits or -, starting with a letter (e.g. notes-api)

outputDir.description: Absolute path of the folder to create the project in

sample.description: Include the sample items feature (default true)

sharing.description: Spaces shared between users with roles and invitations (default false)

templateRef.description: Override the pinned backend template tag

name: backend_generate
